record.question: Kunga earns Rs 16000 per month. He spends 1/4 of his income on food, 3/10 of the remainder on house rent and 5/21 of the remainder on education of children. How much money is still left with him?
record.explanation: Food=4000; remainder=12000. Rent=3/10×12000=3600; remainder=8400. Education=5/21×8400=2000; remaining=6400. Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
